title: Entregar consumer contínuo e shutdown recuperável

scope.goal: Supervised continuous consumer over the durable outbox with configurable poll/backoff, bounded concurrency, lease heartbeat, poison dead-letter, graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT drain-or-release shutdown, fail-closed startup, dependency-injected periodic sweeps (sweepExpiredApprovals + journal releaseExpired) and queue counters/lag metrics.
scope.fixtures: synthetic only; disposable PostgreSQL 127.0.0.1:55432/cvg_aaa16_test; operational port 5432 never used
scope.handlers: controlled/synthetic only (noop or deterministic published runtime); no external effects, no provider/channel
scope.out_of_scope: AAA-21/D01 runtime-choice composition; no durable ApprovalEngine/EffectJournalPort composition in the entrypoint (sweeps dependency-injected only)
scope.safety: production rejected; opt-in continuous mode; control plane and outbox are the only ports consumed

changes: createContinuousWorker: single supervised pump with bounded concurrency (1..10), poll interval, exponential idle/error backoff
claims via adapter.claimNext(leaseMs) then dispatches through completeClaimedOutboxEvent (no double claim)
per-event heartbeat: renews through optional adapter.heartbeatClaim or verifies processing+leaseOwner and fails closed on lease loss
counters for claimed/processed/failed/deadLettered/handoffs/errors/claimFailures/leaseLost/heartbeats/idlePolls/released/lag
structured JSON logs (redacted) and metrics only with allowlisted attribute dimensions
stop({drainMs}) stops polling, stops injected sweeps, waits in-flight, then releases lease via adapter.fail; idempotent, non-restartable
parseContinuousWorkerSettings(env) with explicit CVG_WORKER_* validation
runSweepTick: effect journal releaseExpired(now, ttlMs) followed by agent-runtime sweepExpiredApprovals with fresh journal evidence
createPeriodicSweepRunner: non-overlapping timer ticks, error containment, stop() awaits in-flight tick, metrics/logs without PII
never touches outbox events, handlers or tool executors
WorkerTelemetry port (log + metric)
createJsonWorkerTelemetry: one redacted JSON line per log/metric via @cvg/observability redactFields
createTelemetryWorkerSink bridge to @cvg/observability Telemetry
extracted completeClaimedOutboxEvent(input) with byte-identical claim/ack/fail semantics
processOutboxEvent now claims once and delegates; existing behavior and tests preserved
new exported ClaimedOutboxEventResult / CompleteClaimedOutboxEventInput types
exported createControlledDispatch for reuse by the continuous worker (no behavior change)
openPostgresControlledConnection: shared fail-closed validation + pool/adapter/platform/handlers (createPostgresControlledWorker behavior preserved)
createPostgresContinuousWorker: supervised worker with env/override tuning and tenant-scoped backlog probe
createPostgresOutboxBacklogProbe: read-only tenant-scoped count of pending + available failed events (no payload columns)
getWorkerStartupFailure: rejects unsupported run modes, requires durable PostgreSQL adapter for continuous mode, validates continuous settings
new codes worker_run_mode_unsupported, continuous_durable_adapter_required, continuous_settings_invalid; existing codes/order preserved
opt-in CVG_WORKER_RUN_MODE=continuous branch for postgres/postgres-controlled adapters
runPostgresContinuousWorker: JSON telemetry, injected sweeps slot (disabled pending AAA-21/D01), shutdown controller bounded by drainMs + 5s, graceful stop before pool.end
one-shot controlled worker path preserved

acceptance_checklist.startup_fail_closed: getWorkerStartupFailure + spawn of the real entrypoint (exit 1, postgres_database_missing); npm run test:worker:startup
acceptance_checklist.continuous_consumption: events enqueued before and after restart consumed by distinct worker instances over the same outbox (memory + PostgreSQL)
acceptance_checklist.bounded_concurrency: max in-flight never exceeds configured concurrency (test 7)
acceptance_checklist.idle_and_error_backoff: 5→10→20→40ms sequence asserted; claim-boundary failure backoff and recovery asserted
acceptance_checklist.lease_heartbeat: ownership verification each leaseMs/3; optional heartbeatClaim renewal seam; leaseLost on third-party takeover; late commit rejected (conflict)
acceptance_checklist.poison_dead_letter: unknown event type dead-lettered on first claim and queue continues; repeated handler failure retried then terminal by repository policy
acceptance_checklist.sigterm_no_loss_no_dup: graceful stop drains in-flight to processed (1 journal record); bounded stop releases lease and a later worker completes the same idempotency key (1 journal record, verified per-event in PostgreSQL)
acceptance_checklist.sweeps_wired: runSweepTick calls journal releaseExpired then sweepExpiredApprovals; periodic runner tested; started/stopped with worker lifecycle; never consumes outbox or runs handlers
acceptance_checklist.observability: worker_outbox_processed_total / failed_total / dead_lettered_total / lag / heartbeats_total / lease_lost_total / errors_total counters; structured JSON logs; redaction test proves no payload/PII
acceptance_checklist.no_production_enablement: NODE_ENV=production rejected; continuous mode explicit; controlled synthetic handlers only
acceptance_checklist.no_forbidden_writes: agent-runtime/approval/persistence/channel product files untouched; package.json/tracking untouched; git diff --check clean
